sourceFile: 10.1.BRS-2015 Report Test material silicone gasket date 4.10.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but the changed-factor grouping and outcome calculations are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly mixes BRS-201506 and X616/X516 conditions as baseline/test.
Baseline should be Normal or old jig normal, not a list including test conditions.
616BOTTOM comparisons ignore date/model/side adjacency and use mismatched rows.
NG counts use defect subcolumns while rates use Total NG, causing inconsistent metrics.
Header-only measurement statistics are not valid outcome evidence.
correctionPlan: Define one changed factor as new Hearing+Bako jig with silicone gasket and Y/S 0.45-0.55T versus normal/old jig normal.
Keep subgroup keys by sheet, date, model, side, and test stage.
Rebuild function outcomes from paired rows and total rows using Input, Total NG, and NG rate consistently.
Use 201506 totals and 616BOTTOM totals as separate outcomes under the same validation context if supported by decision rows.
Remove fabricated measurement stats based only on header rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because grouping and metric use are wrong.
